channel.title: Proxly Updates
channel.description: Updates for Proxly - Smart Browser Chooser

item.title: Version 1.2.3
item.description:
• **Memory Leak Resolution**: Eliminated memory leaks in URL processing through hybrid architecture refactoring
  • **Regex Caching**: Implemented thread-safe regex pattern caching to prevent repeated compilation
  • **State Management**: Extracted stateless processing logic to prevent memory accumulation on high-volume URL processing
  • **Thread Safety**: Fixed concurrent access crash in regex cache with proper barrier synchronization
  • **Sparkle Gentle Reminders**: Implemented proper gentle reminder support to eliminate background update warnings
  • **File Logging**: Enhanced Logger with file-based logging to daily .log files for better debugging
  • **Update Notifications**: Added rich user notifications for background updates with "Install Now" and "Later" action buttons
  • **Notification Handling**: Improved user experience with proper notification permission requests and response handling
